methods.label: Recover the price multiplier
methods.explanation: \(50(1-x)^2=40.5\), \((1-x)^2=0.81\), \(1-x=\pm0.9\), so \(x=0.1\) or \(x=1.9\) (the rate of price reduction cannot exceed 1, so this is discarded). Therefore, each price reduction is 10%.
